install.windows_download: Download https://gemini.google/download/windows/ (follow redirects) to the user's Downloads folder as GeminiSetup.exe. This is the official Windows download linked from https://gemini.google/desktop/.
install.macos_download: Download https://gemini.google/download/mac/ (follow redirects) to ~/Downloads/Gemini.dmg, or use the macOS download at https://gemini.google/desktop/.
install.linux: NOT SUPPORTED. Use the web version at https://gemini.google.com/ on Linux.
install.note: Windows requires Windows 10 or later (x64 or ARM64), at least 8 GB RAM and 200 MB free disk space. macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) or later; Intel Macs are unsupported. A stable internet connection and a Google account with access to Gemini are required. Windows installation and update guidance: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/18263854.

install_flow.summary: Check OS and architecture → download the official installer → open it and hand off to the user → verify after the user finishes.
agent_steps: Check the local OS, architecture and requirements in install.note. Windows 10+ x64/ARM64 and macOS 15.0+ Apple Silicon are supported. For unsupported systems, offer https://gemini.google.com/.

Windows: download the official windows_download URL with Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile to a resolved full path under the user's Downloads folder named GeminiSetup.exe. macOS: download the macos_download URL with curl -L -o to ~/Downloads/Gemini.dmg. If an entry point fails, read https://gemini.google/desktop/ for the current official download link; do not invent a CDN URL or WinGet package ID.

After a successful download, tell the user the EXACT saved file path. Windows: open it with Start-Process -FilePath using that resolved path, without -Wait. macOS: open the .dmg with `open ~/Downloads/Gemini.dmg`.

Windows: tell the user to finish the GeminiSetup.exe installer. macOS: tell the user to drag Gemini.app to Applications. Do NOT automate the GUI install or use unverified silent flags. Stop this turn after handing off; downloading or opening the installer is not installation success.
When the user returns after completing installation, verify Gemini appears in the Start menu on Windows or /Applications on macOS and opens. Leave Google sign-in to the user inside Gemini.
tell_user: Whether the installer opened and which steps the user must finish
Whether installation and first launch were verified after the user completed setup

update.windows: Open Gemini. When an update notification appears, let the user choose Restart to update. Do not invent CLI update commands or overwrite Gemini CLI configuration.

identity_guard.description: Gemini Desktop is Google's official GUI app from gemini.google/desktop/. It is not Gemini CLI (@google/gemini-cli), a third-party desktop wrapper, or a browser shortcut. Sign in inside the app; do not configure it through ~/.gemini/settings.json.

blocked_regions.zh-CN: gemini.google may be blocked in mainland China — a VPN/proxy is usually required.
